Splitting the sum according to the values of $D_k$:
1. $k=1$ to $18$: $D_k = 4$.
   Sum $= 4 \sum_{k=1}^{18} (65 - 2k) = 4 [ 18(65) - 2 \frac{18 \times 19}{2} ] = 4 [ 1170 - 342 ] = 4(828) = 3312$.
2. $k=19$ to $30$: $D_k = 3$.
   Sum $= 3 \sum_{k=19}^{30} (65 - 2k) = 3 [ 12(65) - 2(294) ] = 3 [ 780 - 588 ] = 3(192) = 576$.
3. $k=31$ to $32$: $D_k = 2$.
   Sum $= 2 \sum_{k=31}^{32} (65 - 2k) = 2 [ 2(65) - 2(63) ] = 2 [ 130 - 126 ] = 2(4) = 8$.
The total sum is $3312 + 576 + 8 = 3896$.
The remainder when $3896$ is divided by $1000$ is $896$.
